project_type: .NET 8 Web API backend with vanilla JavaScript SPA frontend
language: JavaScript (ES6), C# for DTOs inspection only
build_system: MSBuild via dotnet CLI - no frontend build step, static files served from wwwroot
test_command: dotnet run --project GymManegement.csproj (manual test at http://localhost:5250)
verification_instructions: Start the API server with 'dotnet run', navigate to http://localhost:5250, login as Admin, and verify each page renders without console errors and API calls succeed
environment_constraints: API runs on http://localhost:5250 (hardcoded in wwwroot/js/api.js). Frontend is a SPA using hash routing. No hot-reload - must refresh browser after JS changes. The member frontend is already complete; this task builds admin-only features.
contribution_requirements: All admin features must check role === 'Admin' before rendering management UI. Follow existing patterns: pagination with pageNumber/pageSize, search with searchTerm, modals with .modal class, toast notifications via showToast/showSuccess/showError. Match existing code style in wwwroot/js/*.js files.
key_patterns: JS modules export async render functions (e.g., renderMembers(container)). Each module has: loadXXX() for API fetch, renderXXXTable(data) for table HTML, renderXXXPagination(data) for nav, showCreateXXXModal() and showEditXXXModal(id) for CRUD modals. Tables use escapeHtml() for XSS safety, formatDate/formatCurrency for display. Role-based nav in app.js uses allowedPagesByRole. API calls via apiFetch(path, options) with JWT from localStorage. Modals use .modal.show CSS class pattern with inline HTML in JS.
directory_structure: wwwroot/ (frontend static files): index.html (SPA shell), login.html, css/style.css, js/ (modules: api.js, app.js, auth.js, dashboard.js, members.js, trainers.js, facilities.js, schedules.js, sessions.js, checkins.js, invoices.js, payments.js, reports.js, users.js, profile.js, member-schedule.js, memberships.js). Controllers/ (API endpoints). API/DTOs/ (request/response models). Service/BUS/ (business logic). DAL/Repositories/ (data access).
